exact_statement: Retains v3 with its original prescribed-tree hypotheses. Adds: every uniform Boolean quadratic phase with at most one vertex flipped, and every fair physical restriction thereof, has a complete continuation with selected coordinate erasure B_i<=5 Inf_i. This extends to products on disjoint blocks. For an OR of any finite number of disjoint such products (and its AND/sign variants), after any physical stopping prefix there exists a complete continuation with B_i<=14 Inf_i at each selected actual query; additional K14-bad odd-face debit is exactly zero. Both full terminal entropies are retained and resolved with remaining influence, giving H<=17I for the complete class and H<=8I for each product. Earlier prefix debits are unchanged and not asserted bounded. This does not transfer a prescribed-tree Phi to a reordered tree. Arbitrary edit sets, arbitrary outer gates, universal net-price selection and full FEI remain open.
hypotheses: Finite disjoint physical blocks, uniform remaining physical bits, entropy in bits
Each inner product factor is a degree-at-most-two F2 phase with no edit or a single vertex edit, with arbitrary affine coefficients and constant sign
Physical adaptive prefix fixes only queried bits; no conditioning on unobserved inner outputs
Outer gate is OR or sign-equivalent AND; arbitrary fan-in but disjoint inner supports
Old booked debits retained; no reuse of old fixed-tree potential after changing component policy
Entropy corollaries use B05 localized reduction with c_JS=2/ln2; all-dimensional pivot/transport proof given separately from finite checks
